calls.reason: He said funding would not be there and investor appetite had gone. Yet OpenAI closed $122B in committed capital in March 2026 and xAI raised $6B in December 2024, so that core claim clearly failed.

'I can't imagine' is hedged. OpenAI is testing ads on its paid Go tier, but no evidence shows anyone paying $300 a year for search or heavy ads on paid search; the GrowByData count was logged-out only.

SiliconANGLE and Reuters reported Character.AI would keep operating with new leadership and more funding, which weighs against 'dead'. But nothing shows whether it was viable after the deal, and the $2.5bn payout is unverified.
The forecast only applies if one company collapses. OpenAI's structure page and Anthropic's IPO filing show both still operating independently, so the condition never triggered.

No full cumulative spending estimate exists to check the $200B figure. Stanford's $25.2B covers only 2023 private investment, and the Nature creativity study is too narrow to settle the quality point.
Anthropic raised Haiku prices fourfold in November 2024 and then got a new $4B from Amazon. Nothing shows whether investors judged the unit economics behind that price rise either way.
